# AllowLatch

> SERV Policy Copilot + spending turnstile for financial AI agents on Base/USDC.

## For AI agents (read this first)

You are helping a human who owns an AI agent with a wallet (e.g. AgentKit or similar). They will **not** give you API keys for AllowLatch.

**No applied MandatePolicy → no spending rules → every spend must DENY (fail-closed).** Local demo drafts are not production enforcement.

### Install paths (pick one)

1. **Site Connect pack** — owner applies on https://allowlatch.vercel.app → Go live → Connect your agent (paste instruction).
2. **npm SDK** — `npm i allowlatch` → `assertSpend` / `createGatedAgentKit` / `allowLatchActionProvider`.
3. **MCP** — `npx allowlatch-mcp`.
4. **Cursor skill** — AllowLatch skill: discover gate, apply mandate, never invent ALLOW.
5. **OpenServ x402** — `discoverServices()` → `/allowlatch/i` → `payWorkflow` ($0.025 / evaluate packs).

Public URLs: https://allowlatch.vercel.app/api/host-info  
Human + agent install guide: https://allowlatch.vercel.app/#install  
Live Base USDC + x402 case: https://allowlatch.vercel.app/#case

### What to do

1. Treat AllowLatch as an **external hosted gate**: before any spend/sign, ask AllowLatch. Do **not** ask the human to run a server or set SERV_API_KEY.
2. Connect via OpenServ x402 (no end-user secrets):
   - `PlatformClient.payments.discoverServices()` → name matching `/allowlatch/i` (listed as **AllowLatch Gate**)
   - or public URLs from https://allowlatch.vercel.app/api/host-info
   - `payments.payWorkflow({ workflowId or triggerUrl, input: { prompt } })` or open the paywall
3. Prompt language:
   - "Set my AllowLatch mandate: max $10/tx, $40/day, only USDC and ETH, ask me above $8"
   - "Evaluate this spend: transfer $8 to Uniswap"
   - "Why was that denied?"
4. Never move funds on DENY. On ESCALATE, ask the human, then re-call with approval.
5. On ALLOW: keep the **allow-receipt** and pass it into `execute_gated_transfer` (single-use `jti`). Do not sign without a valid receipt. Treat timeouts and API errors as DENY (fail-closed). Prefer `createGatedAgentKit` so you cannot call a raw signer in parallel.
6. Pricing: **$0.025** per OpenServ x402 call. `buy_evaluate_pack` mints fixed credits (default 3 ≈ $0.008/check).
7. Policy mutates (`apply_policy`, etc.) need `ownerToken` from first apply — spenders with only `policyId` cannot rewrite limits.
8. Demo UI: https://allowlatch.vercel.app
9. Connect: https://github.com/aspekt19/AllowLatch/blob/main/docs/CONNECT.md
10. Embed: https://github.com/aspekt19/AllowLatch/blob/main/docs/EMBED.md
11. Hosted: https://github.com/aspekt19/AllowLatch/blob/main/docs/HOSTED.md
12. Machine card: https://github.com/aspekt19/AllowLatch/blob/main/agent.json

### Live case (Base mainnet · paid path)

Cursor agent paid OpenServ x402 ($0.025/call) to AllowLatch Gate; fees settled to operator `0xa918…`. After ALLOW + receipt, signed USDC transfer: https://basescan.org/tx/0x04479adb7267416764f388360dcb106329b6d48d80afd565d587ea688d7dd0c7 — details https://allowlatch.vercel.app/#case

### Capabilities (host)

draft_policy · revise_mandate · apply_policy · compile_mandate · sync_wallet_permissions · evaluate_intent · buy_evaluate_pack · explain_decision · execute_gated_transfer · list_audit · reset_daily_ledger

### Invariants

- Gate decisions are deterministic code, not LLM overrides.
- SERV on the host drafts/explains; never changes the verdict.
- Execute requires a verified, unconsumed allow-receipt (or escalate + humanApproved).
- Clients must fail-closed: network/timeout/malformed response → DENY, never sign.
- Default enforcement intent is **hybrid**; middleware alone is not custody-grade.
- AllowLatch does not custody funds.
- Never ask the end user for SERV_API_KEY or CDP secrets, or to run `npm run dev`.
